authors: Ueda T, Mori Y, Nakagaki T, Kobatake Y
title: Action spectra for superoxide generation and UV and visible light photoavoidance in Plasmodia of Physarum polycephalum
why: Gives action spectra for photoavoidance in the same plasmodium, which would replace the invented colour weights of the slime view with measured ones; as printed in the Nakagaki 1996 reference list (not opened).

title: Action spectrum in sporulation of the myxomycete Physarum nudum
why: Sporulation action spectrum for a close relative of the plasmodium; as printed in the Nakagaki 1996 reference list (not opened).

title: The myxomycete Physarum nudum as a model organism for photobiological studies
why: Review of the photobiology of P. nudum, with the action spectra of several responses; as printed in the Nakagaki 1996 reference list (not opened).

authors: Wald G, Brown PK, Kennedy D
title: The visual system of the alligator
why: Alligator photopigment and visual system measurements, the basis for any measured alligator colour or sensitivity row; reference as printed in the Martinez and Plummer 2022 chapter (not opened).

title: The visual cells of the alligator: an electron microscopic study
journal: Vision Research (volume as printed in the chapter: 61: 323-329, which looks wrong; check)
why: Photoreceptor ultrastructure of the alligator, the only electron-microscope study of its visual cells named in the chapter; reference as printed (not opened).

title: Studies on the retina. The structure of the retina of Alligator mississippiensis and its photomechanical changes
why: Retinal structure and the movement of pigment and cells with light in the alligator; reference as printed (not opened).

authors: Fleishman LJ, Howland HC, Howland MJ, Rand AS, Davenport ML
title: Crocodiles don't focus underwater
why: Measured focus of crocodilian eyes in air and under water, which would set the depth and focus rows for the alligator view; reference as printed (not opened).
rows: alligator:Field of view, sharpness, dim light and depth

authors: Whittaker C, Ofri R, Heaton-Jones T, Kubilis P, Tu H, Brooks D
title: Electroretinography in the American alligators (Alligator mississippiensis) (printed as 'Eletrorretinography')
why: Electroretinograms from alligators give a measured flicker or light response for the alligator view; reference as printed (not opened).

title: Electron microscopy of retinal tapetum (Caiman crocodilus)

why: The tapetum of a caiman, the only crocodilian tapetum described at this level in the chapter; reference as printed (not opened).

title: The fine structure of iridial constrictor pupillae muscle of Alligator mississippiensis
why: The muscle that sets pupil shape and size in the alligator, the basis for a measured pupil row; DOI as printed in the chapter (not opened).

authors: Derobert Y, Medina M, Rio JP, Ward R, Reperant J, Marchand MJ, Miceli D
title: Retinal projections in two crocodilian species, Caiman crocodilus and Crocodylus niloticus
